intro.label: Yo Ho Ho! Pirate Cafe Grand Opening!

view.summary: Run the pirate cafe for 90 seconds: send maids to carry the right dishes to each table before customers give up, clear the tables, and fill the Fever gauge for a rush of auto-served orders. Satisfaction (score) unlocks harder shifts and Proficiency bonuses.

overview.title: A shift

items.label: Yo Ho Ho! Pirate Cafe Grand Opening!

items: Maids take dishes from the food counter to the tables. Each maid holds up to 2 dishes; a dish nobody needs can go in the trash can.
The maid is frozen for 1 s
A customer whose wait runs out leaves without paying any Satisfaction
The table has to be cleaned before the next customer, which also earns Satisfaction
Correct orders fill the gauge (max 125). In Fever, maids serve automatically while customers stream in and order the special dish.
From Normal on, a special customer sometimes comes in with a bigger, better-paying order and more Fever gauge
A rerun mode with its own missions (no daily reward).

pages.title: Gameplay
pages.text:
■ Serve the customer's order within the time limit.

■ Earn Satisfaction score by serving the correct order.

■ If the order is not served within the time limit, the customer will leave and no satisfaction score will be earned.

pages.title: Fever Mode
pages.text:
■ If the order is served correctly, the Fever gauge will increase.

■ When the Fever gauge is filled, Fever Mode will be activated.

■ In Fever mode, a maid will be automatically selected to serve food.

pages.title: Maid
pages.text:
■ Mast, Anchor, and Sin will appear to serve dishes to customers while on duty.

■ The number of maids available varies based on the difficulty.

■ Each maid can hold a maximum of 2 dishes at a time.

pages.title: Food/Trash Can
pages.text:
■ This area is where the food for customers is placed.

■ The types of food available vary based on the difficulty.

■ Dishes held by the maids can be discarded in the trash can.

pages.title: Satisfaction
pages.text:
■ Serve food or clean up to earn Satisfaction score.

■ Complete daily missions to get rewards based on the Satisfaction score earned.

■ The Satisfaction score earned from a single game will be reflected in the Union Ranking.

pages.title: Proficiency
pages.text:
■ Your level will increase according to the Satisfaction score earned.

■ Certain buffs can be obtained from reaching specific levels.
